name: As Water Cascades
summary: Sacred water is brought to bear on the red crystal in Darkshore. Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea hopes moonwell water from Auberdine will reveal what lies beneath its opaque surface.

sections.title: Purifying the Unknown
sections.body: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea seeks a safe way to study the red crystal high on Darkshore's eastern cliffs. Moonwell water holds divine, restorative magic, blessed by the night elves' devotion to Elune. Glynda believes water from Auberdine's moonwell may react with the strange stone and pierce its opaque shell without destroying it.

sections.title: The Shadow of Felwood
sections.body: Felwood's corruption makes the eastern ridge a dangerous place to investigate. The forest above Darkshore was twisted by demonic energies during the Third War, and Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea fears the red spire may be linked to that corruption. As sacred water trickles over the crystal's lattice, the humming stone briefly turns transparent. What lies within calls for a closer look.

faq.q: Where do I get the water for this quest?
faq.answer: Draw water from the moonwell in Auberdine, the night elf settlement, with the empty vial Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea provides.

faq.q: Why does moonwell water affect the crystal?
faq.answer: Moonwells hold consecrated water rich with magic, blessed by Elune. Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea expects its purifying essence to react with the stone's foreign energy and reveal its hidden composition.

faq.q: Where is the red crystal located?
faq.answer: The red crystal rests along Darkshore's eastern mountain wall, set into the rocky foothills between the shore and the highlands above.

faq.q: Why is Sentinel Glynda worried about Felwood?
faq.answer: Felwood lies east and above Darkshore, scarred by demonic corruption from the Third War. Since the crystal appeared near the boundary ridge, Glynda fears it may share that demonic origin.

faq.q: What happens when you pour the water on the crystal?
faq.answer: Sentinel Glynda expects the potent moonwell water to reveal a clue to the crystal's composition. Its reaction becomes clear when you pour the water over it.

faq.q: Who gives the quest As Water Cascades?
faq.answer: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine gives you this work after the reconnaissance mission called The Red Crystal.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei, you know moonwells as sacred fonts of life and solace. Using their consecrated waters to reveal what lies within a strange formation shows how Elune's grace helps untangle threats along your borders.
As a druid, you watch over Darkshore's fragile ecosystem and have reason to distrust unnatural formations, especially along the ridge below corrupted Felwood.
As an Alliance member, you know the scouts based in Auberdine must keep the coast secure from corruption creeping down from the eastern highlands.
